revisionDesc.change: Vote - AcceptText - Fine, but line3: <:τετά<ρ>της=PN C. Balamoshev (From photo)|ed|τετάρτης:>; 11. => <:{.5}=PN Heidelberg Seminar (digital image)|ed|{ἔτ̣ο̣υ̣ς̣}:>; 3, 8, 11-12: from foto => digital image

Vote - AcceptText - The new reading in line 3 is correct. Lin8 the new reading of Φαλετε certainly looks better than Φαλεγο̣ς̣ (http://www.trismegistos.org/nam/detail.php?record=11067 possibly offers the name involved) lin11 {ἔτ̣ο̣υ̣ς̣} is indeed unlikely. Whether the suggested { ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ ̣ε̣ι̣} is better I am not sure. An epsilon with a long iota in ligature is certainly possible, although I do wonder whether the "iota" is not just a fold / mark on the papyrus. The original reading {ἔτ̣ο̣υ̣ς̣} indicated a clear epsilon, which I do indeed see. I wonder whether ιε Θὼθ was written and then deleted by the scribe, because it was then written again in the next line.
Corrections in BL 8.403 & checked the photo available online.
